# storage-cloudflare

## Environment variables

| Variable | Services | Optional | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | api | yes | Access key id of an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on the bucket, from R2 → Manage API tokens. The Worker binding is a different credential and cannot sign a URL, which is why this exists. Set it in `packages/env/.env` locally, run `pnpm env:setup`, and use `wrangler secret put R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` in production. |
| `R2_ACCOUNT_ID` | api | yes | Cloudflare account id, from the dashboard URL or `wrangler whoami`. One of four optional values that together let this provider hand a browser a presigned URL. Leave them unset and reads and writes still work through the R2 binding — every upload and download just streams through the Worker's proxy route instead. |
| `R2_BUCKET_NAME` | api | yes | Name of the bucket the S3-compatible URL addresses, e.g. `acme-storage`. It must be the bucket the `BUCKET` binding points at, or every presigned link answers `NoSuchBucket` while uploads still work. `apps/api/test/r2-bucket.test.ts` compares the two in `packages/env/.env` and `.env.prod`; a value only a remote source holds is not checked. |
| `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | api | yes | Secret access key shown once when the R2 API token is created. A secret: never in wrangler.jsonc, never in a repo. `wrangler secret put R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` in production. |
